profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Google
profile.summary:
I am a backend engineer with experience in: Java, C++, C#, Python, SQL, JavaScript, and TypeScript. I have published apps for both iOS and Android and have also published a research paper in the Journal of Hardware and Systems Security. 
Please visit my GitHub at: https://github.com/juan8831

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Building the next gen end to end encryption infrastructure for billions of users!

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Collaborated on an Agile Kanban team to develop new features (back-end and front-end) for the UltiPro Tax Engine, an ASP.NET web application with RabbitMQ message queuing and SQL Server and MongoDB databases
• Created unit, integration, functional, and performance tests using the NUnit, FakeItEasy, and Selenium frameworks and verified test results with TeamCity continuous integration

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
• Developed and optimized several C# applications for a Department of Defense research project involving Windows and Linux virtual machine malware detection with machine learning
• Integrated new features into the project codebase, built with C# (ASP.NET and WPF), SQL Server, Python, and Go

positions.title: Java Grader
positions.description:
• Evaluated weekly Java programming assignments based on grading rubric.
• Provided students with feedback on code organization and structure.

positions.title: Research Intern in Cyber-Physical Systems Security Lab
positions.description:
• Worked under the supervision of Dr. Selcuk Uluagac in the FIU Cyber-Physical Systems Security Lab to investigate the security of internet-of-things devices.
• Presented weekly reports on research papers from the major security conferences such as IEEE S&P, USENIX, and NDSS.
• Coauthored a survey on available function and system call hooking techniques for Windows, macOS, Android, iOS, and Linux. 
• Published survey in the Journal of Hardware and Systems Security.

positions.title: Software Developer Intern
positions.description:
• Participated in 10-week Summer Technology Analyst - Software Developer Program
• Consolidated several codebases from different lines of business into a single C# WPF application
• Reduced total lines of code by approximately 40%, improving code maintainability
• Increased code coverage by approximately 20% using the NUnit and Rhino Mocks frameworks
• Prepared weekly presentations for sprint reviews with the project’s product owner
• Selected to showcase project in the firm's final technology internship presentations

projects.title: QRme
projects.description:
QRme integrates attendance tracking with comprehensive event management functionality. 
Published on Apple App Store and Google Play Store

Tech Stack: HTML, CSS, Typescript, Angular 5+, RxJS, Ionic 3, Cordova, Google Firebase-Firestore

CREATE PERSONALIZED EVENTS
* Create public or private events
* Pick specific dates for your event (one time or recurring)
* Assign a category to your event so that is easily searchable
* Administer event join requests and uninvite unwanted invitees 
* Choose when invitees can record their attendance
* Manage the attendance records of your invitees
* Create polls and blog posts to share with your invitees

JOIN EVENTS
* Find events by name, category, or by scanning a QR code 
* Request access to private events 
* Record your attendance through manual attendance or by scanning a QR code
* View your attendance record 
* Vote in polls 
* Read and comment on event blog posts

projects.title: Ultimate Restaurant
projects.description:
A realtime restaurant order and customer management web application developed using Angular 5+ and Google FireStore. It allows customers to create restaurant orders and view their previous order history. Admins can view and fulfill orders, and they can dynamically change the availability of the menu items. Order information is updated in real-time for both customers and admins. 

Tech Stack: Angular, Firebase-Firestore, Typescript
